headerDisplay: One TV tile for a Samsung The Frame: tap for true power on/off, pick Art Mode or a source as the input. Pair with the Frame first (see the README). The tile is published as its own accessory: add it in the Home app with this bridge's setup code.

tvIp.title: Frame IP address
tvIp.description: Give the Frame a fixed IP (DHCP reservation).

tvMac.title: Frame MAC address
tvMac.description: Optional. Used for Wake-on-LAN; learned from the Frame automatically while it's on. Set it if the Frame is wired, or to wake it before it has been seen once.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Inputs shown in the tile besides Art Mode. Defaults to HDMI 1.

key.title: Key
key.description: Samsung remote key that selects it.

pythonPath.title: Python interpreter
pythonPath.description: Python 3.10 or newer, used to build the plugin's own environment.
